sources.title: Stefan Kopecz and Andreas Meister, On order conditions for modified Patankar-Runge-Kutta schemes
sources.locator: §1; §2, equations (4)–(7) and Lemmas 2.6–2.7; §3.1, Theorem 3.3; §3.2, equations (19)–(22) and Theorems 3.4–3.5.
sources.support: The full text defines conservative production-destruction systems, gives the modified Patankar-Euler and MPRK formulas, proves unconditional positivity and conservation for positive inputs, and derives the MPRK22 order conditions. The local items independently prove their matrix, zero-factor extension, Taylor expansion and global-error applications; the source is not treated as proof acceptance.

contents.support: The local definition fixes the donor/destination indices and proves no solution-regularity assertion by definition.

contents.support: The carrier states the exact linear system, admissible input domain and standard denominator choice.

contents.support: The source gives the same matrix-sign and transfer-pair route; the local proof supplies a complete strict-column-dominance and Neumann-series argument.

contents.name: §2, original two-stage MPRK formula; §3.2, Theorem 3.5 identifies MPRK22(1)
contents.support: The local algorithm implements only the specific positive-interior alpha=1 method and preserves its stage and final denominators.

contents.name: §3.2, Theorems 3.4–3.5 and complete order expansion proof
contents.support: The source confirms the second-order denominator choice; the local proof independently expands the selected scheme and states its positive-tube hypotheses.

contents.reason: The source establishes local order conditions, not this item's fixed-time compact-tube global estimate. The latter is proved from the actual batch-28 supplier.

contents.name: Positive-input denominator assumptions and the distinction between MPRK families
contents.support: The local definition adds an explicit source-factorization hypothesis for zero compartments; it is not inferred from the positive-state source theorem.

contents.name: MPRK22 order result at zero stages or under denominator regularization
contents.reason: The source's MPRK order claims assume positive components and do not prove the separate zero-compatible first-order extension.

contents.reason: The residual certificate is proved from the exact finite-precision supplier; the Patankar order paper does not supply that arithmetic bound.

contents.name: The strict column-dominance / nonnegative-inverse step used by the Patankar matrices
contents.support: The local lemma supplies a complete nonnegative Neumann-series proof instead of relying on the source citation to M-matrix theory.

contents.name: §3.1, Theorem 3.3: first-order denominator condition
contents.support: The local proof uses sigma_i=y_i^n on a compact strictly positive tube and proves its own defect and one-step bound.

contents.name: Positive-state ratio formula adapted by factoring each transfer through its donor
contents.support: The source formula is defined with positive denominators; the local factorized algorithm is a separately stated extension and removes the ratio at zero.

contents.name: §3.2, Lemmas 2.6–2.7: positivity and conservation for the original MPRK method
contents.support: The local proof establishes stage and final matrix properties for the exact alpha=1 scheme and arbitrary positive step size.
